name: Bench Dips
description: Bench Dips. Dips between benches, triceps dips with bench, triceps dips with chair, triceps dips with support, triceps dips with assistance, triceps dips on bench.
instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with your hands gripping the edge of the bench, fingers pointing forward.
2. Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
3. Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
4. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lateral Raises (Dumbbell)
description: Lateral Raises, Dumbbell Lateral Raises, Side Raises. Shoulder lateral raises, Lateral flyes, Lateral raises, Deltoid raises, Lateral lifts with dumbbells.
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
2. Keep your back straight and engage your core.
3. Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
4. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: One Arm Row (Dumbbell)
description: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row, One-Arm Dumbbell Row. Unilateral row with dumbbell, One-arm row with dumbbell, Supported row, Bent-over row with dumbbell, One-arm row.
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing your body.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
3. Let the dumbbell hang straight down towards the floor, with your arm fully extended.
4. Pull the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

name: Seated Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
description: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press, Seated Dumbbell Military Press. Dumbbell military press, Seated shoulder press, Vertical press with dumbbells, Dumbbell deltoid press.
instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
2. Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
3. Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
4. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Unilateral Bayesian Curl on Low Pulley (Cable)
description: One Arm Cable Bicep Curl, Single Arm Cable Curl. Unilateral bicep curl with pulley, One-hand cable curl, Individual arm curl on pulley, Bicep curl with cable to one arm.
instructions:
1. Stand facing away from a low cable pulley, grasping the handle in one hand.
2. Step forward to create tension, with your arm extended behind your body.
3. Keep your elbow slightly behind your torso throughout the movement.
4. Curl the handle forward and upward toward your shoulder.
5. Squeeze your biceps at the top, emphasizing the stretched position.
6. Slowly extend your arm back to the starting position.
7. Complete all repetitions on one side before switching.

name: EZ Bar Curl
description: EZ Bar Curl, EZ Bar Bicep Curl. Curl with Z bar, Bicep curl with EZ bar, Curl with Roman bar, Bicep curls with EZ bar.
instructions:
1. Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
2. Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
3. Exhale as you curl the barbell up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
4. Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale as you slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Close Grip Preacher Curl (EZ Bar)
description: EZ Bar Preacher Curl, Preacher Curl. Bicep curl on preacher bench, Scott curl, Scott bench curl with EZ bar, Concentration curl on bench.
instructions:
1. Sit on a preacher curl bench and place your upper arms on the pad, gripping the ez barbell with an underhand grip.
2. Rest your triceps on the pad and fully extend your arms, keeping your back straight.
3. Slowly curl the barbell towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
4. Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
5. Lower the barbell back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hip Adduction (Machine)
description: Adductor Machine, Inner Thigh Machine. Adductor machine.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the backrest.
2. Place your feet on the footrests and grasp the handles for stability.
3. Engage your adductor muscles and slowly bring your legs together, squeezing your inner thighs.
4. Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then slowly return to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Reverse Grip EZ Bar Preacher Curl
description: Reverse Grip EZ Bar Preacher Curl, Reverse Preacher Curl. Preacher curl with pronated grip, Reverse Scott curl, Preacher bench curl with inverted grip, Reverse bicep curl on preacher, Pronated curl on Scott bench.
instructions:
1. Sit on a preacher bench with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
2. Grasp the EZ barbell with an overhand (pronated) grip, palms facing down, hands shoulder-width apart.
3. Rest your upper arms on the pad, allowing your forearms to hang down.
4. Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders.
5. Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Elevación De Pierna Tumbado Con Palanca (Maquina)
Machine Hammer Grip Preacher Curl
description: Preacher curl with hammer grip on machine, Scott curl with hammer grip, bicep curl on machine with neutral grip, preacher curl with hammer grip, Scott curl with neutral grip on machine, bicep curl on preacher bench with neutral grip.

name: Machine Reverse Grip Preacher Curl
description: Machine Reverse Grip Preacher Curl, Reverse Grip Machine Curl. Preacher Curl with Supinated Grip on Machine, Reverse Scott Curl on Machine, Reverse Bicep Curl on Machine, Preacher Curl with Palms Up.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine.

4. Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the handles towards your shoulders.
5. Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.

7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Decline Crunch
description: Crunches on decline bench, crunch on inclined bench, decline abdominal crunches, crunch on inclined plane, abdominal flexions on decline bench, abdominal contractions on decline bench.
instructions:
1. Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
2. Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
3. Engage your abs and lift your upper body towards your knees, curling your torso.
4. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Weighted Decline Crunch
description: Decline Crunch with Weight, Weighted Crunch on Decline Bench.
instructions:
1. Lie flat on a decline bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
2. Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
3. Engage your abs and slowly lift your upper body off the bench, curling forward until your torso is perpendicular to the ground.
4. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Ab Crunch (Machine)
description: Seated Ab Crunch Machine, Machine Ab Crunch.
instructions:
1. Sit on the leverage machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
2. Grasp the handles or place your hands on the side pads for support.
3. Engage your abs and slowly lean back, allowing the pad to move with you.
4. Once your upper body is at a 45-degree angle, contract your abs and crunch forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
5. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release and return to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bicep Curl (Resistance Bands)
description: Bicep Curl (Resistance Bands). Other names: Curl with elastic bands, Bicep curls with elastics.
instructions:
1. Stand on the middle of a resistance band with both feet, shoulder-width apart.
2. Grasp the ends of the band with an underhand grip, arms fully extended at your sides.
3. Keeping your elbows close to your body, curl your hands toward your shoulders.
4. Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement.
5. Slowly lower your hands back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Standing Bicep Curl (Straight Bar)
description: Bicep Curl with Bar.
instructions:
1. Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, hands close together.
2. Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
3. Exhale as you curl the weights while contracting your biceps. Continue to raise the bar until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level.
4. Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
5. Inhale as you slowly begin to bring the barbell back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cross Mountain Climbers
description: mountain climbers / Cross Mountain Climbers / Mountain Climber / Cross Mountain Climber in Plank
instructions:
1. Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
2. Engage your core and lift your right foot off the ground, bringing your right knee towards your left elbow.
3. Return your right foot to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left foot towards your right elbow.
4. Continue alternating sides, moving at a controlled pace.
5. Keep your hips level and avoid lifting your hips too high or sagging them too low.
6. Maintain a steady breathing pattern throughout the exercise.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bilateral Biceps Curl (Cable)
description: cable biceps curl / Bilateral Biceps Curl (Cable) / Biceps Curl with Cable / Biceps Curl with Pulley
instructions:
1. Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Grasp the cable handle with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
3. Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary.
4. Exhale and curl the cable handle towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
5. Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
6. Inhale and slowly lower the cable handle back to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Close-Grip Bicep Curl (EZ Bar)
description: ez barbell biceps curl / Close-Grip Bicep Curl (EZ Bar) / Bicep Curl with EZ Bar / Bicep Curl with Narrow Grip
instructions:
1. Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the EZ barbell with an underhand grip, hands close together on the inner angles of the EZ bar.
2. Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
3. Curl the barbell up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
4. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Unilateral Hip Abduction
aliases: Abductores a una pierna en máquina
instructions:
1. Sit on the hip abduction machine and place one leg against the outer pad.
2. Keep the other leg stationary.
3. Push your working leg outward away from center.
4. Pause at the point of maximum contraction.
5. Slowly return to the starting position.
6. Complete all repetitions on one leg before switching.

name: Drag Curl
instructions:
1. Stand facing a low cable pulley with a straight bar attachment.
2. Grasp the bar with an underhand grip at shoulder width.
3. Instead of curling normally, drag the bar upward along your torso by pulling your elbows back.
4. Keep the bar in contact with your body throughout.
5. Squeeze your biceps at the top.
6. Lower the bar by reversing the movement.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Low Cable Crossovers (Cable)
description: Low Cable Crossover, Low Cable Fly. Crossovers on pulley for upper chest, Low pulley flys, Low cable crossovers, Low pulley fly, Cable flys from below.
instructions:
1. Attach cables to both sides of a cable machine at the lowest position.
2. Stand in the center of the machine with one foot slightly in front of the other.
3. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and extend your arms out to the sides.
4. Keep a slight bend in your elbows and maintain a slight forward lean.
5. Engage your chest muscles and bring your arms forward in a sweeping motion.
6. Pause for a moment at the center, then slowly return your arms back to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Calf Raise (Smith Machine)
description: Smith Machine Calf Raise, Standing Calf Raise. Calf raises on Smith machine, Heel raise on multipower, Calves on Smith machine, Calf raises on Smith.
instructions:
1. Adjust the smith machine bar to a height just below your shoulders.
2. Stand facing the bar with your feet hip-width apart and toes pointing forward.
3. Place the balls of your feet on the edge of a step or platform, with your heels hanging off.
4. Hold onto the bar for support, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
5. Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
6. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Decline Push-up
description: Decline push-ups, push-ups with feet elevated, elevated leg push-ups, push-ups with legs raised, push-ups with feet high, push-ups on bench.
instructions:
1. Place your hands on the ground slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, with your feet elevated on a stable surface.
2. Keep your body in a straight line from head to toe, engaging your core muscles.
3. Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
4. Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise (Machine 2)
description: Leg Press Calf Raise. Calf raise on leg press, Calf raise on press, Calf press, Heel raise on leg press machine, Calves on press.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat of the leg press machine so that your knees are slightly bent when your feet are on the sled.
2. Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the sled, with your toes pointing forward.
3. Release the safety handles and push the sled away from you by extending your knees and ankles.
4. Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the sled back down by bending your knees and ankles.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cable Wrist Curl
description: Wrist Curl with Cable, Forearm Curl with Pulley, Wrist Flexion on Low Pulley.
instructions:
1. Attach a straight bar to a low pulley cable machine.
2. Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
4. Rest your forearms on a bench or pad, with your wrists hanging off the edge.
5. Keeping your forearms stationary, exhale and curl your wrists upward as far as possible.
6. Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Wrist Curl (Straight Bar)
description: Wrist Curl with Straight Bar.
instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
2. Hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
3. Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
4. Slowly curl your wrists upward, bringing the barbell towards your forearms.
5. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Decline Bench Press
description: Barbell Decline Bench Press, Negative Incline Bench Press, Decline Chest Press.
instructions:
1. Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
2. Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
4. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lever Gripper Hands
description: Cierre de pinza para agarre.

name: Seated Chest Stretch
description: Este ejercicio sirve para abrir el pecho, mejorar la postura y estirar la zona pectoral y la parte anterior de los hombros. Es útil especialmente si pasas mucho tiempo sentado, encorvado o trabajando frente al ordenador. En la imagen se aprecia principalmente la activación/estiramiento del pectoral mayor.
aliases: Seated Arm Crossover and Chest Out on a Chair
instructions:
1. Siéntate en una silla con la espalda recta y los pies bien apoyados en el suelo.
2. Levanta los brazos a la altura de los hombros, colocándolos hacia los lados.
3. Mantén los codos ligeramente flexionados y las palmas orientadas hacia abajo o hacia delante.
4. Lleva los brazos suavemente hacia atrás, abriendo el pecho sin forzar.
5. Saca pecho y mantén el abdomen firme, evitando arquear demasiado la zona lumbar.
6. Mantén la posición entre 15 y 30 segundos respirando de forma tranquila.
7. Vuelve despacio a la posición inicial y repite de 2 a 4 veces.

name: Cable Standing Wrist Roll
description: Movimiento de enrollado con polea.

name: Single Arm High Cable Row
description: Single Arm High Cable Row, One Arm Lat Pulldown. Unilateral lat pulldown, One arm pull, Row with one arm on high pulley, Vertical pull to one hand.
instructions:
1. Attach a handle to a cable machine at the highest position.
2. Kneel down facing the cable machine and grab the handle with one hand.
3. Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
4. Pull the handle downward toward your chest, driving your elbow back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement.
6. Slowly release the handle back up to the starting position under control.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
8. Switch sides and repeat the exercise with the other arm.

name: Romanian Deadlift (Smith Machine)
description: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift, Smith Machine Stiff Legged Deadlift. Stiff leg deadlift on Smith, Stiff leg deadlift on multipower, RDL on Smith machine, Straight leg deadlift on Smith.
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
2. Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Bend at your hips and lower the barbell towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
4. Lower the barbell until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
5. Engage your hamstrings and glutes to lift the barbell back up to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Smith Machine Front Squat
description: Smith Machine Front Squat. Front squat on multipower, guided front squat, front squat with bar in front on Smith machine, front squat on machine, front grip squat on Smith, front bar squat on guided machine.
instructions:
1. Set up the smith machine with the barbell at shoulder height.
2. Stand facing the barbell with your feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
4. Step back and position the barbell on your front shoulders, resting it on your collarbone and deltoids.
5. Keep your chest up, back straight, and core engaged.
6. Lower your body by bending at the knees and hips, as if sitting back into a chair.
7. Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
8. Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
9. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Good Mornings (Straight Bar)
description: Barbell good morning / Good Mornings (Straight Bar) / Trunk Flexion with Bar / Good Mornings with Bar.
instructions:
1. Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell resting on your upper back.
2. Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge forward at the hips, pushing your buttocks back as if you were trying to touch the wall behind you with your glutes.
3. Lower your torso until it is parallel to the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
4. Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position by squeezing your glutes and pushing your hips forward.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Leg Extension
description: Leg Extension, Knee Extension. Leg extension, Knee extension on machine, Quadriceps extension, Quadriceps kick.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height and backrest of the machine to fit your body.
2. Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footpad.
3. Grasp the handles or sidebars for stability.
4. Extend your legs forward by straightening your knees, lifting the weight.
5. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the weight back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Reverse Pec Deck Fly
description: Reverse Pec Deck Fly, Rear Delt Machine Fly. Reverse fly on machine, Reverse birds, Rear openings, Rear flys on machine.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
2. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms slightly bent.
3. Exhale and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the handles back and outward, away from your body.
4. Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Horizontal Leg Press
description: Horizontal Leg Press, Seated Leg Press. Horizontal leg press, seated press, horizontal leg press, quadriceps press, leg press on machine.
instructions:
1. Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
2. Lie on your back on the sled machine with your feet on the footplate.
3. Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly angled outwards.
4. Grip the handles of the sled machine for stability.
5. Engage your glutes and core muscles.
6. Push through your heels and extend your legs to lift the sled.
7. Lower the sled back down by bending your knees and hips.
8. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Pendulum Squat
description: Pendulum Squat, Leverage Squat Machine. Squat on pendulum machine, Squat on leverage machine, Guided squat, Squat on pendulum machine.
instructions:
1. Position yourself in the pendulum squat machine with your back against the pad and feet on the platform.
2. Place your feet at about shoulder-width, slightly forward on the platform.
3. Unrack the weight and lower your body by bending your knees.
4. Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform.
5. Drive through your feet to push yourself back up to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Reverse Pec Deck Machine (Parallel Grip)
description: Reverse Pec Deck Machine (Parallel Grip). Reverse flys on machine, reverse birds on machine, rear openings on machine, rear flies on machine, rear deltoid openings on machine, reverse flyes on machine.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
2. Grasp the handles with a parallel grip, palms facing each other, and keep your arms slightly bent.
3. Exhale and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the handles back and outward, away from your body.
4. Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lateral Raises (Machine)
description: Lateral Raises Machine. Lateral flyes on machine, Guided lateral raises.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
2. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms straight.
3. Exhale and raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor.
4. Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Inclined Reverse Fly (Dumbbell)
description: dumbbell low-angle fly / Inclined Reverse Fly (Dumbbell) / Rear Fly with Dumbbell / Reverse Fly with Dumbbell
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
3. Extend your arms straight down towards the ground, palms facing each other.
4. Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lift your arms out to the sides and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
5. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Isometric Squat Without Weight
description: Squat without equipment or weight. Bend your knees and lower while keeping your torso straight. Hold the bent position for a few seconds before rising back up. Move up and down in a controlled manner.
instructions:
1. Stand with your back against a wall and feet shoulder-width apart, about half a meter from the wall.
2. Slide your back down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor and knees are at 90 degrees.
3. Keep your back flat against the wall and your core engaged.
4. Hold this position for the desired duration.
5. Push through your heels to slide back up to standing.

name: Smith Low Bar Squat
description: Smith low bar squat.
instructions:
1. Set up the smith machine with the barbell at a height that allows you to comfortably rest it on your upper back.
2. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned outwards.
3. Step under the bar and position it across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
4. Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
5. Unrack the bar by straightening your legs and stepping back from the rack.
6. Take a deep breath and brace your core.
7. Initiate the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
8. Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
9. Keep your chest up and your back straight throughout the movement.
10. Drive through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
11. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Squat Jerk
instructions:
1. Clean the barbell to your shoulders or unrack it from a rack at shoulder height.
2. Dip slightly by bending your knees.
3. Explosively drive the bar overhead while dropping into a full squat position.
4. Receive the bar overhead with arms locked out.
5. Stand up from the squat to full extension.
6. Lower the bar back to your shoulders.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Split Jerk
instructions:
1. Clean the barbell to your shoulders or unrack it at shoulder height.
2. Dip slightly by bending your knees.
3. Explosively drive the bar overhead while splitting your legs into a lunge position.
4. Receive the bar with arms locked out, one foot forward and one back.
5. Recover by stepping your front foot back and rear foot forward to stand upright.
6. Lower the bar to your shoulders.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Sled Push
instructions:
1. Stand behind a loaded sled and grip the high handles.
2. Lean into the sled with your arms extended.
3. Drive forward by pushing off with each leg alternately.
4. Keep your core tight and maintain a low body angle.
5. Continue for the desired distance.

name: Kickboxing Fast Front Kick (Heavy Bag)
description: Igual que la patada frontal, pero ejecutada con mayor velocidad y retorno inmediato a la guardia.

name: Overhead Squat (With Weight)
description: Ejercicio de sentadilla en el que se sostiene un disco por encima de la cabeza con los brazos extendidos durante todo el movimiento. Trabaja principalmente los cuádriceps, mientras el core, los glúteos y los hombros ayudan a estabilizar la postura y mantener la carga alineada.
instructions: Colócate de pie con los pies separados al ancho de los hombros y sujeta un disco con ambas manos por encima de la cabeza. Mantén los brazos extendidos, el abdomen activado y la espalda recta. Desciende en una sentadilla flexionando caderas y rodillas de forma controlada, sin perder la alineación del disco sobre la cabeza. Baja hasta donde tu movilidad lo permita y luego empuja con los pies para volver a la posición inicial.

name: Single Arm Tricep Pushdown
description: Single Arm Tricep Pushdown, One Arm Cable Tricep Extension. One-arm tricep extension, Unilateral tricep pushdown, One-arm cable tricep extension, One-arm tricep push.
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the cable machine.
2. Hold the cable handle with your right hand, palm facing down, and position your arm so that it is fully extended and parallel to the ground.
3. Keep your elbow stationary and close to your body.
4. Slowly bend your elbow, lowering the cable handle towards the back of your head.
5. Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then extend your arm back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and perform the exercise with your left arm.

name: Close Grip Bench Press (Barbell)
description: Close Grip Bench Press, Narrow Grip Bench Press. Bench press with narrow grip, Closed press, Triceps press on bench, Bench press for triceps.
instructions:
1. Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
2. Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Lower the barbell to your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in close to your body.
4. Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Single Arm Tricep Pushdown
description: Single Arm Tricep Pushdown, One Arm Tricep Extension. One-arm tricep extension, Unilateral tricep pushdown, Katana tricep extension with pulley, Tricep pushdown with one arm.
instructions:
1. Stand sideways to a low cable pulley and grasp the handle with the far hand.
2. Position your arm across your body with the elbow bent at approximately 90 degrees.
3. Keeping your upper arm stationary, extend your forearm outward in a sweeping motion, as if drawing a katana.
4. Squeeze the triceps at full extension.
5. Slowly return the handle to the starting position.
6. Complete all repetitions on one side before switching to the other arm.

name: Open Grip Military Press (Smith Machine)
description: Close Grip Military Press (Smith Machine). Shoulder press with close grip, Narrow grip military press.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Lift the bar off the rack and position it at shoulder level, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
4. Press the bar upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
5. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to shoulder level.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Dip Machine
description: Seated Dip Machine. Dips on machine, Seated dips, Dip machine, Triceps press on machine, Assisted dips on machine.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height so that your feet are flat on the ground and your knees are at a 90-degree angle.
2. Grasp the handles of the leverage machine with your palms facing down and your arms fully extended.
3. Slowly lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
4. Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Machine Shrugs
description: Machine Shrugs. Shrugs on machine, Trapezius raises on machine, Shrugs on machine, Trapezius shrugs, Shoulder raises on machine.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine with your back against the pad.
2. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms straight.
3. Keeping your back straight, lift your shoulders up towards your ears as high as possible.
4. Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lying French Press with Pronated Grip (Straight Bar)
description: barbell lying extension / Lying Triceps Extension (Straight Bar) / Lying Triceps Extension / Triceps Extension with Bar. Skullcrushers
instructions:
1. Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your head at the end of the bench.
2. Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, and extend your arms straight up over your chest.
3. Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the barbell towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
4. Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Shoulder Shrugs (Machine 2)
description: leverage machine back extension / Shrug Without Grip (Machine) / Shoulder Shrug / Trapezius Shrug
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine.
2. Grasp the handles with your palms facing inwards and your arms fully extended.
3. Keeping your back straight, exhale and elevate your shoulders as high as possible.
4. Hold the contraction for a brief moment, then inhale and slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Row
description: Barbell Row, Bent Over Row, Pendlay Row. Row with barbell, Inclined row, Pendlay row, Yates row, Horizontal row with barbell, Inclined barbell row.
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
2. Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
4. Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Side Plank
description: Support your forearm on an elevated surface. Extend your legs and torso away from the bench. Keep your body straight using your abs.
instructions:
1. Lie on your side with your forearm on the ground directly under your shoulder.
2. Stack your feet on top of each other or stagger them for balance.
3. Lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from head to feet.
4. Keep your core braced and your hips from sagging.
5. Hold for the desired duration.
6. Lower and repeat on the other side.

name: Plank With Hip Twist
instructions:
1. Start in a forearm plank position.
2. Rotate your hips to the right, lowering them toward the floor.
3. Return to center.
4. Rotate your hips to the left.
5. Return to center.
6. Keep your core engaged throughout.
7. Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Frog Plank
description: frog plank / Frog Plank / Plank with Open Legs / Plank with Frog Legs
instructions:
1. Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
2. Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back straight.
3. As you lower your body, lift your feet off the ground and bring your knees towards your chest.
4. Hold this position for a few seconds, then extend your legs back out and push yourself back up to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Full Plank
description: full plank / Full Plank / Plank / Plank
instructions:
1. Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your fingers pointing forward.
2. Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, lifting your feet off the ground.
3. Continue shifting your weight forward until your body is parallel to the ground, balancing on your hands.
4. Hold this position for as long as you can, maintaining a straight body line.
5. Slowly lower your feet back to the ground and return to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Treadmill
instructions:
1. Step onto the treadmill and grip the handrails for stability.
2. Start the machine at a low walking speed.
3. Walk with a natural gait, swinging your arms naturally.
4. Maintain an upright posture with your core engaged.
5. Adjust speed and incline as desired.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Ski Ergometer
instructions:
1. Stand facing the ski ergometer and grasp the handles overhead.
2. Pull the handles downward in a powerful motion, hinging at the hips.
3. Drive the movement with your lats, core, and legs.
4. Allow the handles to return overhead as you straighten your body.
5. Maintain a steady rhythm.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Walking Machine
instructions:
1. Step onto the walking machine and hold the handrails for initial stability.
2. Set your desired speed and begin walking.
3. Walk with a natural stride, maintaining an upright posture.
4. Swing your arms naturally once you feel balanced.
5. Adjust speed and incline as desired.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Hand Bike
instructions:
1. Sit at the hand bike machine and adjust the seat height.
2. Grasp the pedal handles firmly.
3. Begin rotating the pedals in a circular motion using your arms.
4. Maintain a steady pace and keep your core engaged.
5. Adjust resistance as desired.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Stationary Bike
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height so your leg has a slight bend at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
2. Sit on the saddle and place your feet on the pedals.
3. Begin pedaling at a comfortable pace.
4. Maintain an upright posture with your core engaged.
5. Adjust resistance as desired.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Battle Rope Raises
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding one end of the battle rope in each hand.
2. Raise both arms overhead simultaneously.
3. Slam the ropes down forcefully toward the ground.
4. Immediately raise your arms again to repeat the motion.
5. Maintain a steady, powerful rhythm.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Air Bike
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height and sit on the air bike.
2. Place your feet on the pedals and grasp the moving handles.
3. Begin pedaling while simultaneously pushing and pulling the handles.
4. Maintain an upright posture and engage your core.
5. Adjust intensity by pedaling faster or slower.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Brisk Walk
instructions:
1. Stand upright with good posture.
2. Begin walking at a brisk pace, faster than a casual stroll.
3. Swing your arms naturally with each stride.
4. Take quick, purposeful steps.
5. Maintain an upright torso and engaged core.
6. Continue for the desired duration or distance.

name: Straight Stationary Bike
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height so your leg has a slight bend at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
2. Sit upright on the saddle and place your feet on the pedals.
3. Grasp the handlebars for stability.
4. Begin pedaling at a comfortable pace.
5. Adjust resistance as desired.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Plank (Resistance Bands)
instructions:
1. Place a resistance band around your wrists or forearms.
2. Get into a standard plank position on your forearms.
3. Maintain tension on the band by keeping your arms at shoulder width or slightly wider.
4. Hold the plank position with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
5. Keep your core engaged throughout.
6. Hold for the desired duration.

name: Reverse Plank
instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with your legs extended and hands placed behind you, fingers pointing toward your feet.
2. Lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
3. Keep your arms straight and shoulders engaged.
4. Engage your glutes and core to maintain the position.
5. Hold for the desired duration.
6. Lower with control.

name: Plank
instructions:
1. Get on the floor on your forearms and toes.
2. Position your elbows directly under your shoulders.
3. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
4. Engage your core and squeeze your glutes.
5. Avoid letting your hips sag or pike up.
6. Hold for the desired duration.

name: Mountain Climbers
instructions:
1. Start in a plank position with your hands under your shoulders.
2. Drive one knee toward your chest.
3. Quickly switch legs, extending the bent leg back while driving the other knee forward.
4. Continue alternating legs at a rapid pace.
5. Keep your hips level and core tight.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Inclined Plank
description: bodyweight sit-up / Inclined Plank / Plank in Incline / Inclined Plank
instructions:
1. Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body straight.
2. Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, bringing your shoulders past your hands.
3. Keep your elbows slightly bent and your body straight as you lean forward.
4. Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Back Extension (Machine)
description: Back Extension Machine. Lumbar extension on machine, Back hyperextension, Lower back extension machine, Column extension on machine, Machine for lower back.
instructions:
1. Adjust the machine to fit your body size and range of motion.
2. Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet secured.
3. Place your hands on the handles or grip bars.
4. Engage your core and slowly lean forward, allowing your back to round slightly.
5. Pause for a moment at the bottom position, feeling a stretch in your lower back.
6. Using your back muscles, slowly raise your torso back to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Reclined Stationary Bicycle
instructions:
1. Sit on the recumbent bike and adjust the seat so your legs have a slight bend at full extension.
2. Place your feet on the pedals and grasp the side handles.
3. Begin pedaling at a comfortable pace.
4. Keep your back resting against the backrest.
5. Adjust resistance as desired.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Skipping Rope
instructions:
1. Hold the jump rope handles at your sides with the rope behind your heels.
2. Swing the rope over your head by rotating your wrists.
3. Jump just high enough to clear the rope as it passes under your feet.
4. Land softly on the balls of your feet.
5. Maintain a steady rhythm and keep your jumps low and efficient.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Rowing Machine
instructions:
1. Sit on the rowing machine and strap your feet into the footrests.
2. Grasp the handle with an overhand grip.
3. Start with your knees bent and arms extended (the catch position).
4. Drive through your legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your lower chest.
5. Reverse the movement: extend your arms, lean forward, then bend your knees to return to the catch.
6. Maintain a smooth, continuous rhythm.
7. Continue for the desired duration or distance.

name: Run
instructions:
1. Begin with a light jog to warm up.
2. Maintain an upright posture with a slight forward lean.
3. Land on the midfoot, avoiding heavy heel strikes.
4. Swing your arms naturally at a 90-degree angle.
5. Keep a steady breathing rhythm.
6. Continue for the desired duration or distance.

name: Battle Ropes
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding one end of the battle rope in each hand.
2. Bend your knees slightly and brace your core.
3. Alternate raising and lowering each arm rapidly to create waves in the rope.
4. Keep the movement powerful and continuous.
5. Maintain a stable lower body throughout.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Kneeling Battle Ropes
instructions:
1. Kneel on the ground holding one end of the battle rope in each hand.
2. Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
3. Alternate raising and lowering each arm rapidly to create waves in the rope.
4. Focus on generating power from your arms and core.
5. Maintain a stable kneeling position.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Kneeling Battle Ropes
instructions:
1. Stand holding one end of the battle rope in each hand.
2. Step forward into a lunge position with one leg.
3. While holding the lunge, alternate raising and lowering each arm to create waves.
4. Maintain a stable lunge throughout the set.
5. Switch the forward leg for the next set.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Hanging Wind SPrints
instructions:
1. Attach a TRX or suspension trainer to an anchor point above you.
2. Lean forward, holding the handles with your arms extended and body at an angle.
3. Drive one knee toward your chest while keeping the other leg back.
4. Rapidly alternate legs in a sprinting motion.
5. Keep your core tight and your body in a straight line.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Eliptical Machine
instructions:
1. Step onto the elliptical machine and place your feet on the pedals.
2. Grasp the moving handles.
3. Begin pedaling in a smooth, elliptical motion.
4. Push and pull the handles to engage your upper body.
5. Maintain an upright posture and steady rhythm.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Walk
instructions:
1. Stand upright with good posture.
2. Begin walking at a comfortable, relaxed pace.
3. Swing your arms naturally.
4. Maintain an upright torso and relaxed shoulders.
5. Continue for the desired duration or distance.

name: Burpee
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
3. Jump your feet back into a plank position.
4. Perform a push-up.
5. Jump your feet forward toward your hands.
6. Explosively jump upward with your arms overhead.
7. Land softly and repeat.

name: Jack Burpee
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
3. Jump your feet back into a plank position.
4. Perform a jumping jack motion with your feet while in plank.
5. Jump your feet forward toward your hands.
6. Explosively jump upward.
7. Land softly and repeat.

name: Up And Down Plank
instructions:
1. Start in a forearm plank position.
2. Press up onto your right hand, then your left, until you are in a full plank position.
3. Lower back down onto your right forearm, then your left.
4. Alternate the leading arm with each repetition.
5. Keep your core tight and minimize hip rotation.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Plank With Hip Abduction
instructions:
1. Start in a forearm plank position with your body in a straight line.
2. Slowly slide one leg out to the side, away from your body.
3. Bring the leg back to the center using your adductor muscles.
4. Repeat with the other leg.
5. Keep your core braced and hips level throughout.
6. Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Plank With Stability Ball
instructions:
1. Place your forearms on a stability ball and extend your legs behind you.
2. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
3. Engage your core to maintain balance on the unstable surface.
4. Avoid letting your hips sag or pike up.
5. Hold for the desired duration.

name: Push-Up To Side Plank
instructions:
1. Start in a standard push-up position.
2. Perform a push-up.
3. At the top, rotate your body to one side, extending the top arm toward the ceiling into a side plank.
4. Hold briefly, then return to the push-up position.
5. Perform another push-up and rotate to the other side.
6. Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cross Plank
instructions:
1. Start in a forearm plank position.
2. Extend your right arm straight forward and your left leg straight back simultaneously.
3. Hold for a moment, engaging your core for balance.
4. Return to the plank position.
5. Repeat with your left arm and right leg.
6. Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Isometric Dip
instructions:
1. Position yourself on parallel bars or dip handles with your arms extended.
2. Lower your body until your elbows are at about 90 degrees.
3. Hold this position, keeping your core engaged and chest slightly forward.
4. Maintain the hold for the desired duration.
5. Push back up to finish.

name: Isometric Dip
instructions:
1. Position yourself on parallel bars or dip handles with your arms extended.
2. Lower your body until your elbows are at about 90 degrees.
3. Hold this position, keeping your core engaged and chest slightly forward.
4. Maintain the hold for the desired duration.
5. Push back up to finish.

name: Dead Hangs
instructions:
1. Grasp a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
2. Hang with your arms fully extended and feet off the ground.
3. Relax your shoulders and let your body weight stretch your lats and spine.
4. Keep your core slightly engaged.
5. Hold for the desired duration.
6. Step down carefully.

name: Single Arm Dead Hang
instructions:
1. Grasp a pull-up bar with one hand using an overhand grip.
2. Hang with your arm fully extended and feet off the ground.
3. Let your body weight stretch your lat, shoulder, and grip.
4. Keep your core engaged to minimize swinging.
5. Hold for the desired duration.
6. Switch hands and repeat.

name: Butt Kicks
instructions:
1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Begin jogging in place.
3. With each step, kick your heel up toward your glute.
4. Alternate legs rapidly.
5. Swing your arms naturally.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Astride Jumps
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet together and arms at your sides.
2. Jump up, spreading your legs apart and raising your arms overhead.
3. Land softly with your feet wide and arms up.
4. Jump again, bringing your feet together and arms down.
5. Continue at a steady pace.
6. Repeat for the desired duration.

name: Bear Crawl
instructions:
1. Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
2. Lift your knees slightly off the ground.
3. Move forward by simultaneously advancing your right hand and left foot, then left hand and right foot.
4. Keep your back flat and hips low.
5. Continue crawling forward for the desired distance or duration.

name: Alternative Punches
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart in a boxing stance.
2. Bring your fists up to guard your face.
3. Punch forward with one arm, rotating your torso.
4. Retract the arm and immediately punch with the other.
5. Alternate rapidly in a continuous rhythm.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Backwards Run
instructions:
1. Stand in an open area with enough clear space behind you.
2. Begin jogging backward with small, controlled steps.
3. Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your core engaged.
4. Look over your shoulder periodically for safety.
5. Maintain an upright posture.
6. Continue for the desired duration or distance.

name: Boxing Bag
instructions:
1. Stand in a boxing stance facing the heavy bag.
2. Keep your fists raised and guard up.
3. Throw combinations of jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts at the bag.
4. Rotate your hips and shoulders with each punch for power.
5. Move around the bag using footwork.
6. Continue for the desired duration or rounds.

name: High Knee Jumps
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Jump up, driving both knees as high as possible toward your chest.
3. Swing your arms to help generate height.
4. Land softly on the balls of your feet.
5. Immediately repeat the jump.
6. Continue for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Ladder Drill
instructions:
1. Place the agility ladder flat on the ground.
2. Stand at one end of the ladder.
3. Quickly step both feet into each square, moving forward through the ladder.
4. Keep your movements light and fast, staying on the balls of your feet.
5. Pump your arms for balance and speed.
6. Repeat the pattern for the desired number of rounds.

name: Boxing With Partner
instructions:
1. Face your partner in a boxing stance with focus mitts or pads.
2. Throw punches at the pads held by your partner.
3. Follow the combinations called out by your partner.
4. Maintain proper form, keeping your guard up between punches.
5. Incorporate defensive movements like slips and rolls.
6. Continue for the desired duration or rounds.

name: Arms Raise Step In Place
aliases: Marcha en el sitio con elevación de brazos
instructions:
1. Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Begin marching in place, lifting your knees to hip height.
3. Simultaneously raise both arms overhead with each step.
4. Lower your arms as you bring each foot back down.
5. Maintain a steady rhythm.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: High Knee Walk
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
2. Run in place, driving your knees up toward your chest as high as possible.
3. Pump your arms in sync with your legs.
4. Stay on the balls of your feet.
5. Maintain a fast pace.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Leg Raise Hold
instructions:
1. Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended.
2. Raise your legs in front of you until they are parallel to the floor.
3. Hold this position, keeping your legs straight and core engaged.
4. Maintain the hold for the desired duration.
5. Lower your legs with control.

name: Isometric Wipers
instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your arms extended to the sides for stability.
2. Raise your legs straight up toward the ceiling.
3. Slowly lower both legs to one side, keeping them straight.
4. Hold at the lowest comfortable point.
5. Return to center and lower to the other side.
6. Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Isometric Chest Squeeze
instructions:
1. Stand or sit upright with your palms pressed together in front of your chest.
2. Push your palms firmly against each other, engaging your chest muscles.
3. Hold the contraction for the desired duration.
4. Release slowly.
5. Repeat for the desired number of sets.

name: Stair Master
instructions:
1. Step onto the stair climber machine and grip the handrails.
2. Begin stepping at a comfortable pace.
3. Maintain an upright posture without leaning heavily on the rails.
4. Drive through each step with your full foot.
5. Adjust speed and resistance as desired.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Run In Treadmill
instructions:
1. Step onto the treadmill and grip the handrails.
2. Start at a walking pace and gradually increase to your target running speed.
3. Run with a natural gait, landing on the midfoot.
4. Swing your arms naturally and maintain an upright posture.
5. Adjust speed and incline as desired.
6. Continue for the desired duration or distance.

name: Handstand
instructions:
1. Place your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart, close to a wall.
2. Kick up into a handstand, resting your heels against the wall for support.
3. Keep your arms straight, core engaged, and body in a straight line.
4. Hold the position for the desired duration.
5. Come down carefully by lowering one leg at a time.

name: Wall Squat
instructions:
1. Stand with your back flat against a wall and feet about half a meter away from it.
2. Slide down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor and knees at 90 degrees.
3. Keep your back pressed against the wall and core engaged.
4. Hold the position for the desired duration.
5. Push through your heels to slide back up.

name: Dragon Flag
instructions:
1. Lie on a bench and grip the edges behind your head for stability.
2. Raise your entire body from shoulders to toes into a vertical position.
3. Slowly lower your body as a rigid unit toward the bench, keeping only your upper back in contact.
4. Lower as far as you can while maintaining a straight line.
5. Pull yourself back up to the vertical position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Shadowboxing
instructions:
1. Stand in a boxing stance with your feet staggered and fists raised.
2. Throw jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts at an imaginary opponent.
3. Incorporate head movement and footwork.
4. Keep your guard up between punches.
5. Move around the space using light, quick steps.
6. Continue for the desired duration.

name: Andar En Cinta De Correr (Con Inclinación)
Handboard Open Hand Grip
description: Colgado en fingerboard.

name: Handboard Slope Hang
description: Trabajo de agarre en tabla.

name: Front Lever
description: Front lever, horizontal plank, front lever, horizontal flag, front flag, horizontal lever.
instructions:
1. Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
2. Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
3. Bend your knees and tuck them towards your chest.
4. Simultaneously, lift your legs up and extend them straight out in front of you, keeping your body parallel to the ground.
5. Hold this position for as long as you can, aiming for a full front lever position.
6. To release, slowly lower your legs back down and return to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hollow Hold
description: Lift your torso and legs simultaneously and hold. Keep your arms and legs extended during the exercise.
instructions:
1. Lie flat on your back with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
2. Press your lower back firmly into the floor by engaging your core.
3. Simultaneously lift your shoulders, arms, and legs a few centimeters off the ground.
4. Keep your body in a banana-like shape with your lower back as the only contact point.
5. Hold this position for the desired duration while breathing steadily.
6. Lower back down with control.

name: Impossible Dips
description: Impossible Dip, Dips on Parallel Bars.
instructions:
1. Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body suspended in the air.
2. Bend your knees and cross your ankles.
3. Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
4. Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Superman Push up
instructions:
1. Start in a standard push-up position.
