6. Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the bar back to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Straight Bar High Pulley Pullover
description: Straight Bar High Pulley Pullover, Cable Pullover. Pullover with cable, Lat pull with straight bar, Pullover on high pulley, Lat extension with bar.
instructions:
1. Attach a straight bar to a high pulley cable machine.
2. Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
3. Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and your palms facing down.
4. Engage your core and keep your back straight as you exhale and push the bar down towards your thighs.
5. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return the bar to the starting position while inhaling.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lat Pulldown (Cable)
description: Neutral Grip Lat Pulldown, Hammer Grip Pulldown. Lat pulldown with neutral grip, Vertical pull with neutral grip, Pulldowns with hammer grip, Machine pull-ups with neutral grip.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height and position yourself facing the cable machine.
2. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
3. Sit down and position your thighs under the thigh pads, keeping your feet flat on the floor.
4. Lean back slightly and keep your chest up, maintaining a neutral spine.
5. Pull the handles down towards your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
6. Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, feeling the contraction in your lats.
7. Slowly release the handles and return to the starting position.
8. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Single Arm High Pulley Pullover
description: Single arm pullover with pulley, single arm lat pull, pullover with one arm on high pulley, unilateral lat extension, single arm pullover with cable, unilateral back pull.
instructions:
1. Attach a single handle to a high pulley cable machine.
2. Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Grasp the handle with an overhand grip and extend your arm fully.
4. Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
5. Pull the handle down towards your side while keeping your elbow close to your body.
6. Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your lat muscle.
7. Slowly release the handle back to the starting position.
8. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
9. Switch sides and repeat the exercise with the other arm.

name: Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown (Machine)
description: Reverse grip lat pulldown, Underhand grip lat pulldown. Pulldown with reverse grip, Supinated chest pulldown, Supinated pull, Dorsal pull with reverse grip.
instructions:
1. Adjust the cable machine so that the pulldown bar is at a height above your head.
2. Sit down on the seat and grab the pulldown bar with an underhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Keep your back straight and lean back slightly.
4. Pull the bar down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the bar back up to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Leg Curl
description: Seated Leg Curl. Seated leg curl, Leg flexion seated, Hamstring curl on machine, Seated hamstring curl, Seated knee flexion, Hamstring curl on machine.
instructions:
1. Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
2. Place your lower legs under the padded lever, just above your ankles.
3. Grasp the handles on the sides of the machine for support.
4. Keeping your upper legs stationary, exhale and curl your legs up as far as possible.
5. Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings.
6. Inhale and slowly lower the lever back to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
description: Weighted Hip Thrust. Other names: Barbell Hip Thrust, Weighted Hip Thrust, Glute Bridge with Bar, Barbell Pelvic Thrust.
instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against a bench and a loaded barbell across your hips.
2. Use a pad on the bar for comfort.
3. Plant your feet flat on the floor at hip-width, knees bent at about 90 degrees.
4. Drive through your heels and thrust your hips upward until your torso is parallel to the floor.
5. Squeeze your glutes hard at the top position.
6. Lower your hips back down with control.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Close Grip High Row
description: Close Grip High Row. Vertical row with closed grip, High row with narrow grip, High pull with closed grip, Row with neutral grip, High row with V-bar.
instructions:
1. Sit on the cable machine with your feet flat on the floor and your knees slightly bent.
2. Grasp the v-bar attachment with a neutral grip, palms facing each other, and your hands close together.
3. Keep your back straight and lean slightly forward from the hips.
4. Pull the v-bar towards your torso by retracting your shoulder blades and squeezing your back muscles.
5. Pause for a moment at the peak of the contraction, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown Machine
description: Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown Machine. Lat pulldown with supinated grip, Pulley to chest with reverse grip, Reverse grip lat pulldown, Inverted pull-ups on machine, Pulldown with supinated grip.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your knees under the pads and your feet flat on the ground.
2. Grasp the handles with an underhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Sit upright with your chest out and shoulders back, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back.
4. Pull the handles down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Supported Glute Bridge on Bench
description: Supported Glute Bridge on Bench. Hip raise on bench, Elevated glute bridge, Pelvic lift on bench, Supported glute bridge, Hip elevation with support, Glute bridge with shoulders supported.
instructions:
1. Sit on the edge of a bench with your back against it and your feet flat on the ground.
2. Place your hands on the bench beside your hips for support.
3. Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then lift your hips off the bench until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
4. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Reverse Hyperextensions (Machine)
description: Reverse Hyperextensions (Machine). Reverse hip extensions, Glute hyperextensions, Reverse lower back extensions, Leg raises on machine, Reverse hip extensions, Hyperextensions for glutes.
instructions:
1. Adjust the leverage machine to fit your body and secure your feet in the foot pads.
2. Lie face down on the machine with your upper body hanging off the edge and your hips resting on the pad.
3. Cross your arms over your chest or place them behind your head.
4. Engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your legs upward until they are parallel to the ground.
5. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Squat (Smith Machine)
description: Smith Machine Squat. Squat on multipower, Guided squat, Squat on Smith machine, Squat on machine.
instructions:
1. Set up the smith machine with the barbell at an appropriate height for your squat.
2. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
3. Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper traps and shoulders.
4. Grip the barbell with a wide grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
5. Engage your core and unrack the barbell, stepping back to clear the rack.
6. Keeping your chest up and back straight, initiate the squat by bending at the hips and knees.
7. Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
8. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
9. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Close Grip Lat Pulldown
description: Close grip lat pulldown, Pull-ups on machine with close grip.
instructions:
1. Sit down on the cable pulldown machine and grab the v-bar attachment with an overhand grip.
2. Adjust the knee pad so that your thighs are secured under it.
3. Keep your back straight and lean back slightly.
4. Pull the v-bar down towards your upper chest while keeping your elbows close to your body.
5. Squeeze your back muscles at the bottom of the movement.
6. Slowly return the v-bar to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Muscle-up
description: Muscle-up. Pull-up with transition, complete pull-up, muscle-up on bar, pull-up with transition to dip, kipping muscle-up, pull-up with transition to dip.
instructions:
1. Start by hanging from gymnastic rings with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
2. Engage your core and pull your body up towards the rings, leading with your chest.
3. As you pull yourself up, allow the rings to rotate naturally so that your palms turn to face towards you near the top.
4. Continue pulling yourself up until your chest is level with the rings and your arms are fully flexed.
5. Reverse the movement by slowly lowering yourself back down to the starting position, letting the rings rotate back.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: High Pulley Reverse Fly
description: High Pulley Reverse Fly. Reverse fly with high pulley, Reverse birds with cable, Rear flies with pulley, Reverse flyes for rear deltoids, Reverse flyes with cable, Rear openings with pulley.
instructions:
1. Set both cable pulleys to the highest position and stand between them.
2. Grasp the left cable with your right hand and the right cable with your left hand, crossing the cables in front of you.
3. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, a slight bend in your knees, and lean forward slightly.
4. With your arms slightly bent, pull the cables apart and outward in a wide arc, squeezing your rear deltoids and upper back.
5. Continue until your arms are extended to the sides and your shoulder blades are squeezed together.
6. Slowly return to the starting position under control.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Sumo Deadlift (Straight Bar)
description: Sumo Deadlift. Deadlift with sumo stance, Deadlift with narrow grip, Deadlift with legs apart, Deadlift with wide stance, Deadlift with wide feet.
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing outwards.
2. Place a barbell on the ground in front of you, centered between your feet.
3. Bend your knees and lower your hips, keeping your back straight and chest up, to grip the barbell with an overhand grip.
4. Engage your core and drive through your heels to lift the barbell off the ground, extending your hips and knees simultaneously.
5. As you lift, keep your chest up and back straight, and push your hips forward to fully engage your glutes.
6. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Good Mornings (Smith Machine)
description: Good Mornings (Smith Machine). Hip hinge with Smith machine.
instructions:
1. Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
2. Place the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
3. Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
4. Lower your torso until it is parallel to the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
5. Engage your glutes and hamstrings to raise your torso back up to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Glute Kickback (Machine)
description: leverage machine hip extension / Hip Extension (Machine) / Glute Extension (Machine)
instructions:
1. Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
2. Place your feet on the footrests and grip the handles for stability.
3. Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then push against the footrests to extend your hips and raise your legs backward.
4. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lat Pulldown (Machine)
description: Lat Pulldown (Machine). Front pull, Pull-ups on machine.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your knees under the pads and your feet flat on the ground.
2. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Sit upright with your chest lifted and your shoulders back, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back.
4. Engage your lats and pull the handles down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Pullover on Bench
description: Dumbbell Pullover on Bench. Pullover with dumbbell on flat bench.
instructions:
1. Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet on the floor.
2. Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight above your chest.
3. Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head until you feel a stretch in your chest and shoulders.
4. Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Rope Pullover on High Pulley
description: Rope Pullover on High Pulley. Pullover with rope on high pulley.
instructions:
1. Attach a rope to the cable machine at the highest setting.
2. Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Grasp the rope with both hands, palms facing down.
4. Extend your arms fully in front of you, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
5. Engage your lats and slowly pull the rope down towards your thighs, keeping your arms straight.
6. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Glute Kickback (Band)
description: band bent-over hip extension / Glute Kickback (Band) / Hip Extension with Band / Bent-Over Glute Kickback
instructions:
1. Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at ankle height.
2. Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Step back to create tension in the band, keeping your knees slightly bent.
4. Hinge at the hips and lean forward, maintaining a neutral spine.
5. Extend your right leg straight back, squeezing your glutes at the top.
6. Lower your right leg back down and repeat with the left leg.
7. Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Decline Pullover (Straight Bar)
description: Barbell decline pullover / Decline Pullover (Straight Bar) / Pullover on Decline Bench / Pullover with Decline Bar.
instructions:
1. Lie down on a decline bench with your head lower than your hips and your feet secured.
2. Hold the barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing away from you) and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Extend your arms above your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
4. Lower the barbell in an arc motion behind your head, feeling a stretch in your chest and shoulders.
5. Pause for a moment, then return the barbell to the starting position by reversing the motion.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Rack Pull
description: Rack Pull (Straight Bar), Barbell Rack Pull.
instructions:
1. Set up a barbell on a rack at knee height.
2. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outwards.
3. Bend at the hips and knees to lower yourself down and grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
4. Engage your core and lift the barbell by extending your hips and knees, pulling your shoulders back and squeezing your glutes at the top.
5. Lower the barbell back down to the starting position by bending at the hips and knees.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Pull Through (Cable)
description: cable pull-through / Pull Through (Cable) / Pull Through with Cable / Pull Through with Pulley
instructions:
1. Stand facing away from the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Grab the rope attachment with both hands and step forward, creating tension in the cable.
3. Bend at the hips and lower your upper body until it is parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight.
4. Engage your glutes and hamstrings to pull your body back up to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lying Neck Flexion (Weighted)
description: Lie face up and hold a weight over your head. Raise your head upwards and lower it in a controlled manner.
instructions:
1. Lie face up on a flat bench with your head hanging off the edge.
2. Place a weight plate on your forehead, holding it securely with both hands.
3. Start with your head in a lowered position.
4. Raise your head upward by flexing your neck in a controlled motion.
5. Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
6. Lower your head slowly back to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Single Leg Hamstring Curl (Machine)
description: Leverage Machine Single Leg Hamstring Curl.
instructions:
1. Adjust the machine to your body and stand facing it, holding the handles for stability.
2. Position the back of one ankle against the padded lever.
3. Keeping your upper body stationary and your standing leg slightly bent, curl the working leg upward by bending the knee and contracting your hamstring.
4. Continue curling until your hamstring is fully contracted.
5. Pause briefly, then slowly lower the lever back to the starting position.
6. Complete all repetitions on one leg before switching to the other.

name: Lower Back Curl
description: Lower back curl / Lower back curl / Back curl / Lumbar curl / Supermans / Lumbar extension.
instructions:
1. Lie flat on your stomach with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
2. Engage your glutes and hamstrings, and slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling your back upwards.
3. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Deadlift (Hex Bar)
description: trap bar deadlift
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the trap bar on the ground in front of you.
2. Bend at the hips and knees to lower yourself down and grip the handles of the trap bar with an overhand grip.
3. Keep your back straight and chest up as you begin to lift the trap bar off the ground by extending your hips and knees.
4. As you lift, focus on driving through your heels and squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
5. Lower the trap bar back down to the ground by bending at the hips and knees, keeping your back straight throughout the movement.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Reverse Hyper on Flat Bench
description: reverse hyper on flat bench
instructions:
1. Lie face down on a flat bench with your hips at the edge and your legs hanging off the bench.
2. Hold onto the bench for stability.
3. Keeping your legs straight, raise them up towards the ceiling as high as you can.
4. Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.
5. Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cat Pose
description: Desde cuadrupedia, redondea y arquea la espalda de forma controlada, coordinando la respiración con el movimiento.

name: Lying Neck Extension (Weighted)
description: Lie face down and hold a weight behind your head. Raise and lower your head in a controlled manner.
instructions:
1. Lie face down on a flat bench with your head hanging off the edge.
2. Place a weight plate or towel-wrapped weight behind your head, holding it securely with both hands.
3. Start with your head in a lowered position.
4. Raise your head upward by extending your neck in a controlled motion.
5. Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
6. Lower your head slowly back to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hip Thrust (Smith Machine)
instructions:
1. Position a bench perpendicular to the Smith machine and sit on the floor with your upper back against the bench.
2. Place the Smith machine bar across your hips, using a pad for comfort.
3. Plant your feet flat on the floor at hip-width distance, knees bent.
4. Unrack the bar and lower your hips toward the floor.
5. Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to thrust your hips upward until your torso is parallel to the floor.
6. Hold the top position briefly, then lower with control.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hip Thrust (Machine)
description: Hip thrust on a weight machine.
instructions:
1. Sit in the hip thrust machine with your upper back against the pad.
2. Position the resistance pad across your hips.
3. Place your feet flat on the footplate at about hip-width.
4. Drive through your heels to thrust your hips upward until your torso is parallel to the floor.
5. Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
6. Lower your hips back down with control.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Neutral Grip Lat Pulldown (Machine)
description: Lat pulldown on a machine using a neutral grip.
instructions:
1. Sit at the lat pulldown machine and secure your thighs under the pads.
2. Grasp the neutral-grip handles with your palms facing each other.
3. Lean back slightly and pull the handles down toward your upper chest.
4. Focus on driving your elbows down and back, squeezing your lats.
5. Pause briefly when the handles reach chest level.
6. Slowly extend your arms to return to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bridge Pose (Setu Bandhasana) – Male
description: Tumbado boca arriba, flexiona las rodillas y eleva la cadera apretando glúteos y manteniendo el cuello relajado.

name: Nordic Curls
instructions:
1. Kneel on a pad with your ankles secured under a fixed surface or held by a partner.
2. Keep your body straight from knees to head.
3. Slowly lower your body toward the ground by extending at the knees, controlling the descent with your hamstrings.
4. Lower as far as you can while maintaining control.
5. Use your hamstrings to pull yourself back up to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Power Clean
instructions:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell on the floor over the middle of your feet.
2. Grip the bar just outside your knees with an overhand grip.
3. Lift the bar to mid-thigh by extending your hips and knees.
4. Explosively extend your hips, shrug, and pull the bar upward.
5. Drop under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a quarter squat.
6. Stand up to full extension.
7. Lower the bar and repeat.

name: Seated Sulek Curl
instructions:
1. Sit on a bench facing a low cable pulley.
2. Grasp the straight bar attachment with an underhand grip.
3. Lean back slightly and position your elbows against your inner thighs.
4. Curl the bar upward toward your chin, keeping your elbows locked in place.
5. Squeeze your biceps at the top.
6. Lower the bar slowly to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Glute Kickback
instructions:
1. Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
2. Keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees, lift one leg upward.
3. Push your foot toward the ceiling until your thigh is parallel to the floor.
4. Squeeze your glute at the top.
5. Lower slowly to the starting position.
6. Complete all repetitions on one leg before switching.

name: Frog Pumps
instructions:
1. Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out to the sides.
2. Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
3. Drive through your heels to thrust your hips upward.
4. Squeeze your glutes at the top.
5. Lower your hips back to the floor.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Wide-Legged Forward Bend (Prasarita Padottanasana)
description: Desde una postura de pie amplia, flexiona el tronco hacia delante desde la cadera, manteniendo la espalda larga y el peso repartido entre ambos pies.

name: Standing Forward Bend (Uttanasana)
description: Desde de pie, flexiona el tronco hacia delante desde la cadera y deja caer brazos y cabeza sin forzar las rodillas.

name: Standing Wide-Leg Forward Bend
description: Con las piernas más abiertas que los hombros, inclina el tronco hacia delante desde la cadera para trabajar la movilidad de la cadena posterior.

name: Child’s Pose
description: Siéntate sobre los talones y lleva el tronco hacia delante con los brazos extendidos o relajados para descargar la espalda.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift (Machine - Pulley)
description: Este ejercicio trabaja principalmente la cadena posterior, con énfasis en glúteo mayor e isquiotibiales de la pierna de apoyo. Además, exige bastante equilibrio, estabilidad del core y control de cadera, por lo que es muy útil para mejorar fuerza unilateral, coordinación y estabilidad lumbopélvica.
instructions:
1. Colócate frente a una polea baja y sujeta el agarre con ambas manos.
2. Apóyate sobre una sola pierna, dejando la otra ligeramente elevada detrás de ti.
3. Mantén la espalda recta, el pecho abierto y el abdomen activado.
4. Inicia una bisagra de cadera, llevando la cadera hacia atrás mientras el torso se inclina hacia delante.
5. Al mismo tiempo, extiende la pierna libre hacia atrás, formando una línea con el tronco.
6. Desciende de forma controlada hasta notar tensión en glúteo e isquiotibiales de la pierna de apoyo.
7. Vuelve a la posición inicial empujando la cadera hacia delante y contrayendo el glúteo.
8. Repite las repeticiones indicadas y luego cambia de pierna.

name: Lying Leg Curl (Machine)
description: Este ejercicio está enfocado principalmente en el trabajo de los isquiotibiales, es decir, la parte posterior del muslo. Se realiza en una máquina específica, en posición boca abajo, flexionando las rodillas para llevar los talones hacia los glúteos. También intervienen de forma secundaria los glúteos, los gemelos y la musculatura estabilizadora de la zona lumbar.
instructions:
1. Acuéstate boca abajo en la máquina de curl femoral.
2. Coloca los tobillos por debajo del rodillo acolchado, de forma que quede apoyado en la parte posterior inferior de las piernas.
3. Sujeta las asas de la máquina para mantener el tronco estable.
4. Mantén la cadera pegada al banco y el abdomen firme durante todo el recorrido.
5. Flexiona las rodillas llevando los talones hacia los glúteos de manera controlada.
6. Aprieta los isquiotibiales en la parte final del movimiento.
7. Desciende lentamente el peso hasta volver a la posición inicial, sin dejar caer la carga.
8. Repite el número de repeticiones indicado en tu rutina.

name: High Bar Squat
description: High Bar Squat, Back Squat. Squat, Crouch, Squat with bar, Traditional squat, Olympic squat.
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
2. Hold the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps or rear delts.
3. Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to lower your body down.
4. Bend at the knees and hips, pushing your hips back and down as if sitting into a chair.
5. Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
6. Keep your knees in line with your toes and your weight in your heels.
7. Drive through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
8. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: 45-Degree Leg Press (Machine)
description: 45-Degree Leg Press, Sled Leg Press. Inclined leg press, Leg press, Inclined press, Leg press at 45 degrees.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat and footplate of the sled machine to a comfortable position.
2. Sit on the sled machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
3. Grip the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
4. Push the footplate away from your body by extending your legs, keeping your heels on the footplate.
5. Continue pushing until your legs are almost fully extended, but without locking your knees.
6. Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the footplate back towards your body by bending your knees.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Box Jump
description: Jump explosively onto an elevated surface.
instructions:
1. Stand facing a sturdy box or platform at about arm's length distance.
2. Position your feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Swing your arms back while bending your knees to load the jump.
4. Explosively jump upward and forward, landing softly on top of the box with both feet.
5. Stand fully upright on the box.
6. Step down carefully and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Single-Arm Cable Rear Delt Fly
description: Single-Arm Cable Rear Delt Fly, Unilateral Cable Rear Delt Raise. Unilateral rear flys, rear raises with pulley, unilateral rear birds, unilateral facepull.
instructions:
1. Stand facing a cable machine with the pulleys set at shoulder height.
2. Grasp the left cable with your right hand and the right cable with your left hand, crossing the cables.
3. Step back slightly and extend your arms in front of you with a slight bend in the elbows.
4. Pull your arms apart and back in a reverse fly motion, squeezing your rear deltoids.
5. Pause briefly when your arms are in line with your body.
6. Slowly return to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Single-Arm Lateral Raises on Low Pulley (Cable)
description: Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise, One-Arm Low Cable Lateral Raise. Single-arm lateral raises with pulley, Unilateral lateral flys on pulley, Cable deltoid raises with one hand, Unilateral lateral flys on pulley.
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the cable machine.
2. Hold the cable handle with one hand, palm facing down, and stand far enough away from the machine so that there is tension on the cable.
3. Keep your arm straight and slowly raise it out to the side until it is parallel to the ground.
4. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arm back down to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

name: Single Arm Cable Rear Delt Fly
description: Single Arm Cable Rear Delt Fly, Unilateral Cable Rear Delt Fly.
instructions:
1. Set a cable pulley to shoulder height.
2. Stand sideways to the machine and grasp the handle with the far hand, reaching across your body.
3. With your arm slightly bent, pull the handle outward and backward in a wide arc, squeezing your rear deltoid.
4. Continue until your arm is extended to the side and your shoulder blade is fully retracted.
5. Slowly return to the starting position under control.
6. Complete all repetitions on one side before switching to the other.

name: Unilateral Leg Extension (Machine)
description: Unilateral Leg Extension, Unilateral Knee Extension. Unilateral Leg Extension, Unilateral Knee Extension on Machine, Unilateral Quadriceps Extension.
instructions:
1. Sit on the leg extension machine with your back against the pad.
2. Hook one foot under the roller pad and keep the other foot free.
3. Extend your working leg upward until it is fully straight.
4. Squeeze your quadriceps at the top of the movement.
5. Lower the weight slowly to the starting position.
6. Complete all repetitions on one leg before switching.

name: Sissy Squat
description: Romanian Squat, Quadriceps Squat, Elevated Heel Squat, Sissy Squat without Machine, Knee Extension Squat.
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward.
2. Hold onto a stable object for balance if needed.
3. Slowly lower your body by bending your knees and leaning back, keeping your torso upright.
4. Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as far as you can comfortably go.
5. Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Clean And Press
instructions:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell on the floor.
2. Perform a clean, bringing the bar to your front shoulders.
3. From the front rack position, press or push press the bar overhead.
4. Lock out your arms at the top.
5. Lower the bar back to your shoulders, then to the floor.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Front Squat
instructions:
1. Set up a barbell on a rack at shoulder height.
2. Step under the bar and rest it across the front of your shoulders, elbows high.
3. Unrack the bar and step back with feet shoulder-width apart.
4. Squat down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your torso upright.
5. Descend until your thighs are below parallel.
6. Drive through your heels to stand back up.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Unilateral Horizontal Leg Press (Machine)
description: Unilateral horizontal leg press. Single leg press, Unilateral push on leg press.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat of the machine so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle when your feet are on the footplate.
2. Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
3. Place your hands on the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
4. Push the footplate away from your body by extending your leg, keeping your back against the backrest.
5. Pause for a moment at the fully extended position, then slowly bend your leg to return to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

name: Front Raise (Straight Bar)
description: barbell front raise / Front Raise (Straight Bar) / Front Shoulder Raise / Front Raise with Bar
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
2. Keep your arms straight and lift the barbell forward and upward until it reaches shoulder level.
3. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cross-Arm Front Squat
description: Barbell front squat / Front Squat (Straight Bar) / Front Squat with Bar / Front Squat with Bar.
instructions:
1. Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
2. Hold the barbell in front of your shoulders, resting it on your collarbone and shoulders.
3. Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your body down into a squat position, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
4. Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
5. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bilateral Lying Reverse Fly (Cable)
description: cable low-angle fly / Bilateral Lying Reverse Fly (Cable) / Reverse Fly with Cable / Rear Fly with Pulley
instructions:
1. Attach a D-handle to a low pulley cable machine and lie face down on a flat bench.
2. Grasp the D-handle with each hand, palms facing down, and extend your arms straight out in front of you.
3. Keeping your arms straight, raise them out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor.
4. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Single Leg Leg Press (Machine)
description: leverage machine single leg leg press / Single Leg Leg Press (Machine) / One Leg Leg Press / Single Leg Leg Press
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat and foot platform of the leverage machine to your desired position.
2. Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the foot platform.
3. Place your hands on the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
4. Push one foot against the foot platform, extending your leg until it is almost fully straight.
5. Pause for a moment, then slowly bend your leg and return to the starting position.
6. Repeat with the other leg.
7. Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Clean-Grip Front Squat
description: barbell clean-grip front squat
instructions:
1. Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell resting on your upper chest, with your elbows pointing forward.
2. Lower your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, as if you are sitting back into a chair.
3. Keep your chest up and your back straight as you lower down, making sure your knees do not go past your toes.
4. Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
5. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Jerk De Potencia
instructions:
1. Clean the barbell to your shoulders or unrack it at shoulder height.
2. Dip slightly by bending your knees.
3. Explosively drive the bar overhead while keeping your feet in the same position.
4. Receive the bar with arms locked out and a slight knee bend.
5. Straighten your legs to full extension.
6. Lower the bar to your shoulders.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Zercher Squat
instructions:
1. Place a barbell in the crook of your elbows, holding it close to your chest.
2. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Squat down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
4. Keep your torso as upright as possible.
5. Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
6. Drive through your heels to stand back up.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Horizontal Leg Press
instructions:
1. Sit on the horizontal leg press machine with your back flat against the pad.
2. Place your feet on the platform at about shoulder-width.
3. Release the safety handles and lower the weight by bending your knees.
4. Lower until your knees are at about 90 degrees.
5. Press through your heels to push the platform away until your legs are almost fully extended.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lever Lateral Raise (Machine)
instructions:
1. Sit on the lateral raise machine and adjust the seat height so the pads rest on your upper arms.
2. Grasp the handles and keep your elbows slightly bent.
3. Raise your arms out to the sides by pushing against the pads.
4. Continue until your arms are roughly parallel to the floor.
5. Pause briefly at the top.
6. Lower slowly to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Smith Machine)
description: Ejercicio unilateral de fuerza para el tren inferior realizado en máquina Smith. Se ejecuta con el pie trasero apoyado sobre un banco y el pie delantero adelantado, pudiendo colocarse sobre una plataforma para aumentar el rango de recorrido. Trabaja principalmente el cuádriceps, con participación importante de glúteos y estabilizadores de la pierna.
instructions: Colócate dentro de la máquina Smith con la barra apoyada de forma segura y un banco detrás de ti. Apoya el empeine de la pierna trasera en el banco y deja la pierna delantera firme delante del cuerpo. Desciende flexionando la rodilla delantera y bajando la cadera de forma controlada, manteniendo el torso erguido. Empuja con el pie delantero para volver a la posición inicial. Repite todas las repeticiones de un lado y luego cambia de pierna.

name: Tricep Extension (Rope)
description: Rope Tricep Pushdown, Cable Rope Extension. Tricep pushdown with rope, Tricep extension with rope, Tricep push with rope, Tricep pressure with rope.
instructions:
1. Attach a rope attachment to a high pulley on a cable machine.
2. Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
3. Grasp the rope with an overhand grip, palms facing each other.
4. Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
5. Exhale and push the rope downward by extending your elbows until your arms are fully extended.
6. Pause for a moment, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position by allowing your elbows to flex.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Face Pull (High Cable, Rope)
description: Face pull, Cable face pull. Facial pull, Face traction, Face row, Face pulls, Face pull with rope.
instructions:
1. Attach a rope handle to a low cable pulley and kneel down facing the machine.
2. Grasp the rope with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) and extend your arms fully in front of you.
3. Keeping your back straight and core engaged, pull the rope towards your body by retracting your shoulder blades.
4. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement and hold for a brief pause.
5. Slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Standing Military Press (Barbell)
description: Standing Military Press, Overhead Press. Standing shoulder press, Shoulder press with barbell, Vertical press, Military shoulder press, Shoulder press.
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly closer than shoulder-width apart.
2. Lift the barbell to shoulder height, keeping your elbows close to your body.
3. Press the barbell overhead, extending your arms fully.
4. Lower the barbell back to shoulder height.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Close Grip Smith Machine Bench Press
description: Close Grip Smith Machine Bench Press. Narrow grip bench press on Smith, Close press on Smith machine, Triceps press on Smith, Triceps bench press on guided machine, Narrow grip press on multipower.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the bench with your feet flat on the ground.
2. Grasp the barbell with a close grip, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
3. Lower the barbell towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
4. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cable Upright Row
description: Vertical pull with cable, standing row with cable, vertical lifts with cable, high row with cable, vertical pulls with cable, shoulder row with cable.
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold the cable attachment with an overhand grip.
2. Keep your back straight and your core engaged throughout the exercise.
3. Pull the cable attachment straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
4. Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Slowly lower the cable attachment back down to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Shoulder Press (Barbell)
description: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press, Seated Military Press. Seated military press, Shoulder press with bar, Seated press with bar, Seated vertical press, Overhead press seated.
instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
2. Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Lift the barbell off the rack and bring it to shoulder level, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
4. Press the barbell overhead by extending your arms fully.
5. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to shoulder level.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Internal Shoulder Rotation (Cable)
description: Cable Internal Shoulder Rotation. Internal rotation with pulley, Internal shoulder rotation with cable, Medial shoulder rotation, Internal rotation with cable machine, Cable for internal rotation.
instructions:
1. Sit on a bench or chair facing the cable machine with your feet flat on the ground.
2. Hold the cable handle with your arm extended straight out in front of you, parallel to the ground.
3. Keep your elbow slightly bent and your shoulder blades pulled back and down.
4. Slowly rotate your arm inward, bringing the cable handle towards the center of your body.
5. Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

name: Tricep Pushdown
description: Tricep Pushdown, Cable Tricep Extension. Tricep pushdown, Tricep extensions with cable, Tricep push on pulley, Tricep extensions with bar.
instructions:
1. Attach a straight bar to a high pulley cable machine.
2. Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
3. Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
4. Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary.
5. Exhale and push the bar down until your elbows are fully extended.
6. Pause for a moment, then inhale and slowly return the bar to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Push Up On Forearms
instructions:
1. Start in a standard push-up position.
2. Lower yourself down so your forearms are flat on the floor, elbows under your shoulders.
3. Press through your hands to push back up to the full push-up position.
4. Lower back down to your forearms.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lying Triceps Extension (Straight Bar)
description: Lying Triceps Extension (Straight Bar). Lying triceps extension, skull crushers, French press lying down, lying triceps extension with bar, supine triceps extension, triceps extension on flat bench.
instructions:
1. Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your head at the end of the bench.
2. Hold the barbell with a reverse grip, palms facing towards your face, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
3. Extend your arms straight up over your chest, keeping your elbows in and your wrists straight.
4. Slowly lower the barbell towards your forehead by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
5. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: V-Bar Triceps Pushdown
description: V-Bar Triceps Pushdown. Triceps extension with V bar, Triceps pushdown with V grip, Triceps extension with pulley and V grip, Triceps press with V bar, Triceps pull with V bar, Triceps push with V grip.
instructions:
1. Attach a v-bar attachment to the cable machine at the highest setting.
2. Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Grasp the v-bar with an overhand grip, palms facing down, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
4. Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
5. Engage your triceps and exhale as you push the v-bar down until your arms are fully extended.
6. Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your triceps.
7. Inhale as you slowly return the v-bar to the starting position, maintaining control.
8. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Smith Standing Military Press
description: smith standing military press
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
2. Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Lift the barbell off the rack and bring it down to shoulder level, with your palms facing forward.
4. Press the barbell upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
5. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to shoulder level.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Incline Tricep Extension (Smith Machine)
description: smith machine incline tricep extension
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat of the smith machine so that the bar is at shoulder height.
2. Sit on the bench with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the ground.
3. Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
4. Extend your arms fully, lifting the bar off the rack and holding it directly above your chest.
5. Lower the bar slowly towards your forehead, keeping your elbows close to your head.
6. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the bar back up to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Overhead Triceps Pulldown (High Pulley)
description: Ejercicio de aislamiento para tríceps realizado con polea alta, en posición inclinada hacia delante y con los codos flexionados por encima de la cabeza. El movimiento consiste en extender los codos contra la resistencia del cable, enfatizando especialmente la cabeza larga del tríceps.
instructions: Colócate de espaldas a la polea alta y sujeta el agarre con ambas manos. Da un paso al frente e inclina ligeramente el tronco, llevando las manos por detrás o por encima de la cabeza con los codos flexionados. Extiende los codos de forma controlada hasta alargar los brazos sin separar demasiado los codos. Regresa lentamente a la posición inicial manteniendo el abdomen firme y los hombros estables.

name: Neutral Grip Machine Row
description: Neutral Grip Machine Row, Hammer Grip Seated Row. Machine row with neutral grip, seated row with hammer grip, row with parallel grip, machine row with palms facing each other.
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat height and footplate position to ensure proper alignment.
2. Sit on the machine with your back straight and feet flat on the footplate.
3. Grasp the handles with a narrow grip, palms facing each other.
4. Keep your chest up and shoulders back throughout the exercise.
5. Pull one handle towards your torso while keeping the other handle stationary.
6. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
7. Slowly return the handle to the starting position and repeat with the other side.
8. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Smith Machine Row
description: Smith Machine Row, Smith Machine Bent Over Row. Inclined row on multipower, Guided barbell row, Row on Smith machine, Horizontal pull on Smith.
instructions:
1. Set up the smith machine with the bar at hip height.
2. Stand facing the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
4. Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
5. Pull the bar towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
6. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Reverse Grip Bent Over Row (Straight Bar)
description: Reverse Grip Bent Over Row (Straight Bar). Bent over row with supinated grip, row with bar and reverse grip, row with supinated grip, Yates row, row with bar and underhand grip, row with reverse grip.
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
2. Hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up, until your torso is almost parallel to the floor.
4. Pull the barbell towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Arm Circles (Warm Up)
instructions:
1. Begin with light activity such as walking or jogging in place for 2-3 minutes.
2. Perform dynamic stretches: arm circles, leg swings, hip rotations.
3. Gradually increase intensity to elevate your heart rate.
4. Focus on mobility for the joints you will use in your workout.
5. Continue until you feel warm and ready to train.

name: Wide Grip Seated Cable Row
description: Wide Grip Seated Cable Row. Seated row with wide grip, row with pulley and open grip, horizontal row with wide grip, low row with open grip, machine row with wide grip.
instructions:
1. Sit at a cable row station with your feet on the footrests and knees slightly bent.
2. Grasp a wide-grip bar attachment with an overhand grip, hands wider than shoulder-width.
3. Sit upright with your chest out and back straight.
4. Pull the bar toward your upper abdomen by retracting your shoulder blades.
5. Squeeze your back muscles at the top of the movement.
6. Slowly extend your arms to return to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Close-Grip Wall Row
description: bodyweight standing close-grip one arm row / Close-Grip Wall Row / One Arm Wall Row / Wall Row with Narrow Grip
instructions:
1. Set a bar at waist height on a Smith machine or rack, or use a sturdy horizontal bar.
2. Grip the bar with both hands close together (narrower than shoulder-width), palms facing away from you.
3. Walk your feet forward and lean back until your arms are fully extended and your body forms a straight line at an angle.
4. Keeping your body rigid and core engaged, pull your chest toward the bar by retracting your shoulder blades and bending your elbows.
5. Pause briefly at the top with your chest near the bar.
6. Slowly lower yourself back to the starting position with control.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Row with Towel
description: bodyweight standing row (with towel) / Row with Towel / Standing Row with Towel / Inclined Row with Towel
instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a towel in front of you with both hands.
2. Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
3. Pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
4. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Incline Bench Row (Cable)
description: cable seated row / Incline Bench Row (Cable) / Seated Row with Cable / Incline Bench Row with Pulley
instructions:
1. Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle and attach a cable handle to the low pulley.
2. Sit on the bench facing the cable machine with your feet flat on the floor and your knees slightly bent.
3. Grasp the cable handle with an overhand grip and extend your arms fully in front of you.
4. Lean forward from your hips while keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
5. Pull the cable handle towards your chest by retracting your shoulder blades and bending your elbows.
6. Squeeze your back muscles at the top of the movement, then slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Isometric Neck Contraction (Lateral)
description: side push neck stretch
instructions:
1. Stand or sit up straight with your shoulders relaxed.
2. Tilt your head to the right, bringing your right ear towards your right shoulder.
3. Place your right hand on the left side of your head and gently apply pressure to increase the stretch.
4. Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
5. Repeat on the other side, tilting your head to the left and applying pressure with your left hand.
6. Repeat the stretch 2-3 times on each side.

name: Seated Hip Abduction (Resistance Bands)
description: resistance band seated hip abduction
instructions:
1. Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
2. Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
3. Place your hands on the sides of the chair or bench for support.
4. Engage your abductors (outer thigh muscles) and slowly push your knees apart, against the resistance of the band.
5. Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bring your knees back together.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bicycle Crunches
description: Ejercicio de core realizado en el suelo, en el que se alterna el acercamiento de una rodilla hacia el torso mientras la otra pierna se extiende, acompañando el movimiento con una flexión del tronco. Trabaja sobre todo el recto abdominal y los oblicuos.
instructions:
1. Túmbate boca arriba.
2. Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza sin tirar del cuello.
3. Eleva ligeramente los hombros del suelo.
4. Lleva una rodilla hacia el pecho mientras extiendes la otra pierna.
5. Alterna el movimiento de piernas de forma continua y controlada.
6. Mantén el abdomen contraído durante todo el ejercicio.

name: Assisted Dip (Bands)
instructions:
1. Loop a resistance band over the dip bars.
2. Place one or both knees in the band.
3. Grip the bars and support your body with arms extended.
4. Lower yourself by bending your elbows until they reach about 90 degrees.
5. Push back up to full extension, assisted by the band.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bottle Weighted Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
Sled Pull
instructions:
1. Attach a harness or straps to a loaded sled.
2. Face away from the sled and lean forward.
3. Drive forward by pushing off with each leg alternately.
4. Keep your body at a forward angle and take powerful strides.
5. Continue for the desired distance.

name: Farmer's Walk
description: Farmer's Walk, Farmer's Carry. Farmer's walk, Farmer's carry, Weighted walk, Dumbbell walk, Weight carry.
instructions:
1. Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
2. Keep your back straight and your shoulders back.
3. Take small, controlled steps forward, maintaining an upright posture.
4. Continue walking for the desired distance or time.
5. To finish, stop walking and carefully lower the dumbbells to your sides.

name: TRX Row
instructions:
1. Grasp the TRX handles and lean back, extending your arms fully.
2. Position your feet forward so your body is at an angle.
3. Pull your chest toward the handles by bending your elbows and retracting your shoulder blades.
4. Squeeze your back muscles at the top.
5. Slowly extend your arms to return to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Wide Neutral Grip Row (Cable)
instructions:
1. Sit at a cable row station with your feet on the footrests and knees slightly bent.
2. Attach a wide neutral-grip handle and grasp it with palms facing each other.
3. Sit upright with your chest out and back straight.
4. Pull the handle toward your midsection by retracting your shoulder blades.
5. Squeeze your back muscles at the top.
6. Slowly extend your arms to the starting position.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Skullcrushers (Dumbbell)
description: Dumbbell French Press, Dumbbell Skull Crusher. Triceps extension lying down with dumbbell, Skull crushers with dumbbell, Lying French press, Triceps extension on bench.
instructions:
1. Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) and your arms extended straight up over your chest.
3. Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the dumbbells down towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
4. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the dumbbells back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Back Extensions
description: Back extensions, Hyperextensions. Lumbar extensions, Hyperextensions of the lower back, Lumbar extensions, Spinal extensions.
instructions:
1. Adjust the hyperextension bench so that your upper thighs are resting on the pad and your feet are secured.
2. Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands behind your head.
3. Lower your upper body towards the ground while keeping your back straight.
4. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then raise your upper body back up until it is in line with your legs.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Seated Wide-Angle Forward Bend (Upavistha Konasana)
description: Sentado con las piernas abiertas, inclínate hacia delante desde la cadera con la espalda larga y sin colapsar el tronco.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Smith Machine)
description: Bulgarian Split Squat (Smith Machine), Smith Machine Rear Foot Elevated Split Squat. Bulgarian lunge on Smith machine, Split squat with elevated foot on Smith machine, Elevated foot lunge on guided machine.
instructions:
1. Stand in front of the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Place one foot behind you on a bench or step, with your toes pointing forward.
3. Hold onto the smith machine bar for stability.

description: Apoya un pie firmemente en el suelo, coloca la planta del otro pie en la cara interna de la pierna de apoyo y mantén el equilibrio con el tronco erguido.

name: Lotus Pose (Padmasana)
description: Sentado, cruza las piernas colocando cada pie sobre el muslo contrario y mantén una postura erguida y relajada.

name: Boxing Right Cross (Heavy Bag)

name: Boxing Right Hook (Heavy Bag)
description: Desde la guardia, gira el tronco y la cadera y dibuja un arco corto con el brazo derecho para golpear el saco lateralmente.

name: Boxing Jab (Heavy Bag)

name: Kickboxing Front Groin Kick (Heavy Bag)

name: Kickboxing Front Kick (Heavy Bag)

name: Kickboxing Hook Kick (Heavy Bag)
